3 BMW India Pvt Ltd 22-Jul-2021 BMW X5, X6 CBU 1393 07/01/2007 07/01/2011 The plug connection from the wiring harness to the blower controller may deteriorate over time.
4 BMW India Pvt Ltd 31-May-2021 BMW 3 Series CBU 1 07/03/2020 07/03/2020 In 2019, BMW decided on a safety-relevant recall for certain vehicles of the E46 (3 series) with a driver's airbag with a singlestage gas generator of the "NADI" type. According to the findings, gas generators of this type from a production period specified by the supplier could leak in the long term.
5 BMW India Pvt Ltd 04-Feb-2021 BMW 7 Series, X7, X6 CKD/CBU 3 30/07/2020 15/10/2020 The hydraulic unit was produced incorrectly.

8 BMW India Pvt Ltd 17-Jul-2020 BMW X6 CBU 1 12-May-20 12-May-20 The hexagon nuts (copper nuts) on the holder of the catalytic converter (near the engine) were tightened to an incorrect torque.
9 BMW India Pvt Ltd 23-Jun-2020 BMW 3 Series CBU 1 17-Mar-99 17-Mar-99 The driver's airbag is equipped with a "NADI" type single-stage gas generator. There have been indications that this type of gas generator can leak in the long term.
10 BMW India Pvt Ltd 19-Jun-2020 BMW Z4 CBU 13 The broken rod leads to a significant impairment of the vehicle's ease of steering. The track rods may break due to increased vibration loads.
11 BMW India Pvt Ltd 04-May-2020 BMW M6 CBU 16 04-Oct-13 31-Mar-16 In the M6, the high-mounted brake light is mounted on the standard CFRP roof using six screw connections. Due to the setting properties of CFRP under pressure and heat, the screw connections lose their preload force and rattle under dynamic stimulation while driving.
12 BMW India Pvt Ltd 04-May-2020 BMW X6 CBU 2 16-Jan-20 22-Jan-20 The upper (roof‐side) rear spoiler of X6 consists of a carrier plate on which the outer shell of the spoiler is bonded. The cause is poor bonding.
13 BMW India Pvt Ltd 04-May-2020 BMW M6, 840I CBU 5 10-Feb-20 02-Mar-20 Hall sensor can switch out due to a too short wiring. With a switched-out Hall sensor, the Airbag for Driver or Passenger won’t work correctly in case of an accident.
14 BMW India Pvt Ltd 04-May-2020 BMW X3M, X4 CBU 8 07-Jun-18 10-Mar-20 Due to a fault in the downstream catalytic converter oxygen sensor heating, the OBD (on-board diagnosis) relevant diagnoses are disabled.
15 BMW India Pvt Ltd 10-Sep-2019 S 1000 RR CBU 25 19-03-2019 27-08-2019 Due to an error in the manufacturing process of the supplier, on oil hoses of the oil cooler (inlet and outlet)crack may come up where the oil hose connects with the oil pipe. In case of cracks, a small amount of oil may leak. The oil cooler needs to be replaced. BMW Motorrad has not received any reports and is not aware of any injuries or fatalities related to the issue.
16 BMW India Pvt Ltd 16-May-2019 MINI Cooper S CBU 153 12-Mar-2018 07-May-2019 Due to a fault in the downstream catalyst oxygen sensor heating, the OBD (on-Board diagnosis) relevant diagnostics are disabled. Another OBD relevant fault may not be indicated by the malfunction indicator lamp. BMW has not received any reports and is not otherwise aware of any injuries or fatalities related to this issue.
17 BMW India Pvt Ltd 06-Mar-2019 BMW 3 Series & BMW 5 Series CKD 312 06-Aug-18 & 03-Aug-18 23-Oct-18 & 24-Sep-18 Cutting oil of mounting nut engages the plastic holder of rear light on the side panel. It may lead to irregular engine running and also reduced drive power, The engine can stop running while driving. A CC message (malfunction indicator lamp on) may not be displayed. BMW has not received any reports and is not otherwise aware of any injuries or fatalities related to the issue.
18 BMW India Pvt Ltd 25-Feb-2019 X5 & X6 CBU 483 Jan-07 & Jan-08 Jun-08 & Oct-08 Malfunctions may occur with the driver's airbag's gas generator, if this is exposed to high absolute humidity or high temperature fluctuations over a period of years and/or there are quality deficiencies in the production of the gas generator. When the driver's airbag is triggered in the regular fashion, this may result in high internal pressure in the gas generator. In unfavourable cases, the gas generator may split and metal parts - possibly fatal - cause injuries. BMW has not received any reports and is not otherwise aware of injuries or fatalities related to this issue.
19 BMW India Pvt Ltd 25-Feb-2019 MINI Cooper S CKD 92 01-Dec-18 31-Jan-19 Cutting oil of mounting nut engages the plastic holder of rear light on the side panel. Holder of rear light on side panel has cracks, or is broken. Check the mounting of rear light on side panel for oil, cracks or breakage. In the test result for replacing the rear light, the mounting nuts must be replaced and the threaded bolts must be cleaned. BMW has not received any reports and is not otherwise aware of any injuries or fatalities related to the issue.
20 BMW India Pvt Ltd 10-Dec-2018 3 Series CBU 18 26-06-02 13-02-02 Malfunctions may occur in the front passenger airbag's gas generator, if this is exposed to high absolute air humidity or high temperature fluctuations over a period of years and/or there are quality deficiencies in the production of the gas generator. When the front passenger airbag is activated in the regular fashion, it may result in high internal pressure in the gas generator. In unfavourable cases, the gas generator may split and metal may escape from the airbag. BMW has not received any reports and is not otherwsie aware of any injuries or fatalities related to this issue.
21 BMW India Pvt Ltd 10-Dec-2018 3 Series CBU 92 28-12-99 28-03-16 Malfunctions may occur in the front passenger airbag's gas generator, if this is exposed to high absolute air humidity or high temperature fluctuations over a period of years and/or there are quality deficiencies in the production of the gas generator. When the front passenger airbag is activated in the regular fashion, it may result in high internal pressure in the gas generator. In unfavourable cases, the gas generator may split and metal may escape from the airbag. BMW has not received any reports and is not otherwise aware of any injuries or fatalities related to this issue.
22 BMW India Pvt Ltd 27-Aug-2018 BMW X3 CKD 8 31-Mar-18 03-May-18 The gas generator for the driver's airbag may not have been manufactured according to the specifications. In the case of a normal activation of the airbag, the gas generator may burst and metal parts could shoot out of the airbag. BMW has not received any reports and is not otherwise aware of any injuries or fatalities related to this issue.
23 BMW India Pvt Ltd 27-Aug-2018 BMW X5 CBU 21 19-Oct-01 22-Feb-02 In case of the wrong software and hardware combination of the airbag control unit in the concerned vehicles, sometimes while parking the vehicle, it may lead to the activation of the front airbag that is not required for occupant safety. This can be particularly the case, when switching off the ignition and simultaneously activating the parking brake. In case of such an activation, injury due to contact with the airbags is not completely impossible. BMW has not received any reports and is not otherwise aware of any injuries or fatalities related to this issue.
24 BMW India Pvt Ltd 20-Aug-2018 BMW 3 Series CBU & CKD 6937 14-10-04 17-01-12 The plug connection from the wiring harness to the blower controller may deteriorate over time. In rare cases, this can lead to overheating and subsequently to a short circuit or melting at the plug-in contact. In very rare cases, this can lead to a fire. BMW has not received any reports and is not otherwise aware of any injuries or fatalities related to this issue.
25 BMW India Pvt Ltd 06-Jul-2018 F5X F60 CBU 1 11-06-18 11-06-18 The crankshaft sensor may have been affected by a manufacturing defect. The signal values of the transmitter wheel for the crankshaft cannot be processed. There is a possibility that the engine stalls in certain circumstances while driving. A Check Control message (malfunction indicator lamp on) is maybe not displayed. BMW has not received any reports and is not otherwise aware of any injuries or fatalities related to this issue.
26 BMW India Pvt Ltd 29-Jun-2018 MINI CBU 4 25-0518 11-06-18 The crankshaft sensor may have been affected by a manufacturing defect. The signal values of the increment wheel for the crankshaft cannot be processed. There is a possibility that, it may lead to irregular engine running and also reduce drive power. A check control message (malfunction indicator lamp ON) is displayed. BMW has not received any reports and is not otherwise aware of any injuries or fatalities related to the issue.
27 BMW India Pvt Ltd 22-May-2018 M5 CBU 13 01-11-17 15-04-18 The fuel pressure drops in certain driving situations due to the electric fuel pump failing to deliver fuel. There is possibility that, the electric fuel pump may not be delivering fuel in certain driving situations. This may cause the engine to stop while driving. BMW has not received any reports and is not otherwise aware of any injuries or fatalities related to this issue.
28 BMW India Pvt Ltd 17-May-2018 BMW E8X E9X CBU & CKD 9362 26-07-07 28-05-12 The plug-in contact of the positive battery cable on the front power distribution box (mounted behind the glove compartment) can be damaged due to vehicle vibrations and the frictional corrosion together with a high load current as a result of these. Damage to the plug-in contact can impair the power supply of the vehicle. There is a possibility that the vehicle entry does not function anymore or that it may no longer be possible to start the vehicle. BMW has not received any reports and is not otherwise aware of any injuries or fatalities related to this issue.
29 BMW India Pvt Ltd 28-Mar-2018 X3 CBU 1 28-09-17 28-09-17 The sealing cap of the pressure limiting value on the fuel delivery unit may be damaged. There is a possibility that, the suction flow pump performance is severely reduced. As a consequence of that, the fuel gauge can show an incorrect indication if a lower fuel delivery rate is present from the left to the right side of the tank. This can cause the engine to stop under certain driving conditions, even if fuel gauge indicated a sufficient fuel level. BMW has not received any reports and is not otherwise aware of any injuries or fatalities related to the issue.
30 BMW India Pvt Ltd 28-Mar-2018 E90 CBU 1 01-12-09 01-12-09 Due to an error in the manufacturing process of the supplier, malfunctions may occur with the driver' airbag's gas generator, if this is exposed to high absolute humidity or high temperature fluctuations over a period of years and/or there are quality deficiencies in the production of the gas generator. BMW has not received any reports and is not otherwise aware of any injuries or fatalities related to this issue.
31 BMW India Pvt Ltd 09-Mar-2018 X3 CBU 2 16-07-17 28-09-17 Due to an error in the manufacturing process of the supplier, in the G01 vehicles, the screws for mounting the rear spoiler may not have been installed in a very small number of cases. BMW has not received any reports and is not otherwise aware of any injuries or fatalities related to the issue.
